answer: Farming becomes a grove bet on surviving 112 epochs of grading, and every tide settlement recomputes the whisper schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 112 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
